question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a purple ball, Bob has a blue ball, Claire has a yellow ball, Dave has a teal ball, Eve has a green ball, Fred has a gold ball, and Gertrude has a pink ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Fred and Alice swap balls. Then, Alice and Claire swap balls. Then, Alice and Dave swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Fred swap balls. Then, Eve and Claire swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Claire swap balls. Finally, Alice and Eve swap balls. At the end of the game, Alice has the
Options:
(A) purple ball
(B) blue ball
(C) yellow ball
(D) teal ball
(E) green ball
(F) gold ball
(G) pink ball
solution:
Ball color order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude.
Initial: purple | blue | yellow | teal | green | gold | pink
1. Fred and Alice swap: gold | blue | yellow | teal | green | purple | pink
2. Alice and Claire swap: yellow | blue | gold | teal | green | purple | pink
3. Alice and Dave swap: teal | blue | gold | yellow | green | purple | pink
4. Gertrude and Fred swap: teal | blue | gold | yellow | green | pink | purple
5. Eve and Claire swap: teal | blue | green | yellow | gold | pink | purple
6. Gertrude and Claire swap: teal | blue | purple | yellow | gold | pink | green
7. Alice and Eve swap: gold | blue | purple | yellow | teal | pink | green
Alice has the gold ball, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
